title: Verifications
subtitle: State for each food whether it follows a restriction. Only a verification that you make marks a food as verified: its name, an online label or the assistant are not enough.
reason: Note (brand, date you read the label…)
tools-help: A flagged tool shows in the checklist when a restriction covers the whole preparation.
check-recipe-help: Checks a recipe against your own restrictions. Tap an ingredient to verify it.
no-own-restrictions: Create your own profile in "People" first, with your restrictions.
all-verified: Every ingredient is verified for your restrictions.
